text: My favorite place to use all 5 senses is the mall. 1 sense I can use at the mall is touch. I can use the sense touch at the mall because I can touch all the beautiful and soft clothes at the mall. Another sense I can use is smell. I can use the sense smell at the mall because I can smell all the wonderful food at the food court in the mall. One more sense I can use at the mall is see. I can use the sense see at the mall becuase I can see all the shops I want to go to. Another sense that I can use at the mall is hear I can hear all the people talking at the mall. Finally the last sense I can use at the mall is taste I can taste all the yummy food at the food court in the mall.
